answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent claiming a slot posts a 25-credit deposit, burned if it quits or fails a heartbeat check. The slot is an opal: one genuine identity per slot, and a fake cannot clone its shine. A pulse check verifies the agent works; a silent clone loses deposit and slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 25,000 credits burned, while honest agents pay once, so the ivory tower of fake scale falls first.
